## description

Runs Python 3.12 with the workspace as the working directory and reports exit_code, stdout and stderr (a traceback appears in stderr). Give path to run a saved program (keep programs as files to improve and reuse them; they can import each other) or code for a quick snippet. Optional args, stdin and timeout_s (default 10, at most 60). The program may read and write workspace files. It cannot use the network, install packages or reach anything outside the workspace; only the standard library is available.

## limitations

[
  "Runs only in container-tier worlds with the subprocess permission; the Simulation refuses any other launch.",
  "No network and no package installation; Python standard library only.",
  "Wall-clock timeout at most 60 s; the whole process group is killed at the limit.",
  "At most 64000 characters of each of stdout and stderr are returned; the rest is dropped and flagged as truncated. Output is decoded as UTF-8 and CRLF line endings become LF.",
  "Memory, process count and CPU are bounded by the container's limits."
]
